row.notes: New row. Appcues prices on monthly active users, installations and published experiences; the pricing page lists Start (up to 3,000 MAUs), Grow (from 3,000 MAUs) and Enterprise (custom MAUs) with no prices, so all price fields stay null. SAML SSO is offered on Enterprise on request and as an add-on for Grow (the SSO doc calls it 'Growth'), set up by Appcues support. The SSO doc says SCIM is not supported. With 'Discoverable for anyone with a matching domain', IdP users join on first SAML sign-in as Publishers (JIT); removal must be done at the IdP or on the Teams page. The Appcues Public API manages flows, end-user profiles, segments and data import/export for the customer's own app users, not Appcues Studio teammates. Okta OIN search returns no Appcues app.

user_api.notes: Appcues has a Public API (API key and secret) for flows, end-user profiles, segments, groups, tags and data import/export of the customer's own app users; no endpoint manages Appcues Studio team members, which are managed on the Teams page. 'false' is by absence for teammate management.
